title: Persist not awaited before the response returns

pr_metadata.title: Speed up signup
pr_metadata.body: Don't block the response on the insert.

labels.defect: Insert fire-and-forget: clients can receive ok=true for signups that failed to persist, and rejections are unhandled
labels.evidence: Reproducible: kill the DB mid-request — response already returned ok=true, user row absent, and an unhandled promise rejection crashes some runtimes; signup confirmation email references a nonexistent account.
